Are you passionate about electronics, testing and automation, and eager to make a direct impact on the quality and manufacturability of high-tech products? Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. In this role, you will develop and implement production test solutions for advanced electronic systems, ensuring products meet the highest quality standards before entering serial production. This employer designs and manufactures highly advanced electronic systems for demanding industries such as semiconductors, industrial, automotive, medical and defense. As a Production Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bridging product development and manufacturing by designing, developing and maintaining production test solutions. You will work closely with hardware, embedded software and manufacturing teams to ensure products can be efficiently and reliably tested throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include: Developing production test strategies and test sequences for electronic products. Designing test hardware, including PCB-based test interfaces, fixtures and measurement circuits. Developing and maintaining automated test software using Python and C++. Performing Design for Testability (DfT) reviews during product development. Designing and maintaining automated production test setups. Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. Performing root cause analysis on production and test failures. Improving test coverage, production yield, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive gross salary in the range of € 3.500 – €5.500 per month excluding 8% holiday allowance, depending on experience, technical expertise and results. Relocation package from Xelvin (see onboarding & benefits).27 paid holidays in addition to public holidays, pension scheme and travel allowance. Holiday allowance of 8% of annual salary. A job with perspective. After the Xelvin contract you will be offered a direct contract with your employer. Career-oriented education, training and development opportunities. Excellent primary and secondary employment conditions. Onboarding & Benefits Your first house in the Netherlands will be arranged by Xelvin, with the help of our relocation team. Furthermore: A relocation assistance allowance will be paid to cover the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and taken to your new home. Onboarding support: assistance with setting up a Dutch bank account, health insurance, BSN registration, dentist and GP registration and other practical matters. We organize several social gatherings throughout the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. Functie-eisen To succeed in this role, you bring: Mandatory Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Electronics / Electrical Engineering only). Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics. Experience designing electronic circuits and printed circuit boards. Must have: Proven experience with Altium Designer. Experience developing test solutions for electronic products. Experience working with laboratory and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQs and signal generators. Experience within electronics manufacturing, semiconductor, embedded systems or power electronics environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent communication skills in English. Some experience with Python and/or C++ (basic). Preferred Experience with automated test systems and production environments. Experience with Design for Testability (DfT). Hier kom je te werken Through their unwavering commitment to excellence, this company strives to create technologies that make the world

Are you an experienced Electrical Engineer with a passion for sustainable energy and innovative power systems? Do you enjoy being involved from the concept phase through to project completion while contributing to the energy transition? If so, this opportunity could be the perfect fit for you. As an Electrical Engineer – Energy Solutions, you will translate customer requirements into smart, sustainable technical solutions. You will design electrical systems for a variety of applications, including distribution centers with limited grid capacity, energy-efficient commercial buildings, and battery energy storage systems. You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from technical preparation and engineering to quality assurance and final commissioning. Working closely with project management and commissioning teams, you will ensure that every system is designed, tested, and delivered to the highest standards. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A permanent position with a minimum of 32 hours per week. A competitive gross monthly salary ranging from €3,800 to €5,900, depending on your experience and qualifications. A company laptop, mobile phone, and company car (depending on the role and experience level). An annual performance or year-end bonus. 8% holiday allowance. 30 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment), with the option to purchase additional leave. Employment conditions in line with the Dutch Metal & Engineering collective labour agreement (CAO Metaal & Techniek). The opportunity to work on innovative and sustainable energy projects that make a real impact on the energy transition. Key Responsibilities Design and develop electrical systems and energy solutions. Create detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation. Translate customer requirements into practical, future-proof engineering solutions. Prepare functional descriptions, operation manuals, and technical documentation. Provide technical support to projectmanagement throughout the project lifecycle. Develop and configure PLC software, including programming controllers and integrating communication protocols such as Modbus TCP within Energy Management Systems (EMS). Prepare test procedures and documentation, including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT). Ensure all designs comply with applicable regulations and industry standards, including NEN 3140 and IEC 62040. About You You are an analytical and solution-oriented Electrical Engineer who enjoys developing innovative energy solutions. You have strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and thrive in multidisciplinary project environments. You also bring: An MBO or Bachelor's degree (or equivalent working and thinking level) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of relevant experience in electrical engineering. Experience creating electrical schematics and technical documentation. Experience with energy storage systems, renewable energy solutions, or similar applications is considered an advantage. Knowledge of communication protocols such as Modbus TCP and experience with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and/or SCADA systems. Experience with engineering software such as EPLAN, AutoCAD, or SEE Electrical. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Dutch is considered an advantage. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a leading engineering company specializing in reliable and sustainable energy solutions. They design, build, and maintain advanced power systems for critical infrastructure, including data centers, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and energy storage applications. By combining innovative technologies with engineering expertise, they deliver intelligent energy solutions that support the transition to a more sustainable future.

As a Service Technician, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and availability of highly automated production equipment. You will be responsible for troubleshooting electrical and control-related issues while identifying opportunities for long-term improvements. Your responsibilities include: Troubleshooting and resolving electrical and PLC-related faults on production equipment. Performing preventive inspections and maintenance to minimize downtime. Identifying root causes of recurring failures and implementing sustainable solutions. Monitoring machine performance and identifying technical risks. Contributing to maintenance improvements and equipment optimization. Recording maintenance activities and findings in the maintenance management system. Collaborating closely with production and maintenance colleagues to maximize equipment reliability. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A full-time position within an international and innovative manufacturing company. A technically challenging environment with highly automated production systems. Opportunities for personal development and technical training. Competitive salary based on experience. Excellent secondary employment benefits. A professional, collaborative, and supportive working environment. Functie-eisen Completed vocational education (MBO Level 3/4 or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. Experience with PLC-controlled machinery and industrial electrical installations is highly preferred. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset. Accurate working style and good administrative skills. Good communication skills in English. With advanced automated production lines and a strong focus on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement, they supply precision-engineeredcomponents to customers worldwide. To strengthen their maintenance team, we are looking for an experienced Service Technician (Electrical Engineering).
